FIS Global | Pune India 
Service Delivery Manager | Senior Scrum Master 
July 2023 – July 2026 
Business Overview 
Led Agile delivery for the Fixed Income Cost Basis (FICB) program supporting enterprise Banking, Capital 
Markets, and Investment Accounting platforms. The program focused on modernizing investment accounting 
capabilities by replacing third -party cost basis and amortization processing with the FIS InvestOne platform. 
Partnered with Product Owners, Business Stakeholders, Architects, Development, QA, and Data Engineering 
teams to deliver secure, scalable, and business -critical solutions while improving operational efficiency, 
reducing vendor dependency. 
Key Responsibilities 
• Lead Agile delivery across multiple Banking, Capital Markets, Loan Accounting, and InvestOne product 
teams, driving sprint execution, release planning, delivery governance, and cross -functional 
collaboration. 
• Partner with Product Owners, Business Product Managers, Architects, Business Analysts, and 
stakeholders to prioritize initiatives, refine product backlogs, and align delivery with business 
objectives. 
• Facilitate Scrum ceremonies, manage dependencies, remove impediments, and ensure predictable 
sprint execution and release readiness. 
• Drive delivery governance through capacity planning, sprint forecasting, risk mitigation, dependency 
management, and continuous delivery improvements. 
• Coach Agile teams on Scrum, Kanban, and Agile best practices while fostering team collaboration, Agile 
maturity, and continuous improvement. 
• Leverage Agile metrics including Velocity, Sprint Predictability, Cycle Time, Lead Time, Throughput, 
Burndown, and WIP to enable data-driven decision-making and transparent stakeholder reporting. 
★ Key Projects 
Project 1: Fixed Income Cost Basis (FICB) Enhancement 
Modernized the Fixed Income Cost Basis (FICB) platform by replacing a third-party vendor solution with 
the FIS InvestOne platform for cost basis and amortization processing. The solution reduced vendor 
dependency, lowered licensing costs, improved operational efficiency, and strengthened investment 
accounting capabilities across the Capital Markets ecosystem. 
. Project 2: CBRS Transfer-In Asset Processing Platform 
This project supports the transfer of investment holdings  between brokerage firms. When an investor 
transfers securities from one broker to another, transfer details are received through the DTCC 
network. The platform processes the incoming transfer data, creates tax lots for the transferred 
securities, and maintains accurate cost basis information for tax reporting and regulatory compliance. 
The solution helps brokerage firms efficiently manage account transfers while ensuring accurate 
investment records.
